title: DesktopIntegrityAdapter
responsibility: Refreshes and verifies the ASAR integrity digest of an experimental desktop app copy.

inputs.name: DesktopIntegrityAdapter.update.app
inputs.description: Path to the explicitly named experimental app copy whose digest is updated.

outputs.name: DesktopIntegrityAdapter.update
outputs.description: Completes after updating and verifying the enabled ASAR integrity digest.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The path is not the experimental copy, its files or enabled integrity are missing, or verification fails.

test.title: copy packaging refreshes the embedded digest and keeps validation enabled
integrity updates refuse the installed original app

value.name: Error
value.message: Integrity changes require the experimental copy
